text:
tamar: Noticed a weird surge (~22x) in fncall validator rejects on /assist in us-east-1 starting ~08:01. Users hitting rerank+toolcall flows.
wes: Any validator errors?
tamar: Snippet from stream:
```
2026-04-11T08:01:03Z validator=fnhook route=/assist region=us-east-1 error="schema: expected OBJECT but got ARRAY at top-level" sample=tte9
2026-04-11T08:01:04Z validator=fnhook route=/assist region=us-east-1 error="toolcall: missing 'tool_name' key" sample=ttea
2026-04-11T08:01:05Z validator=fnhook route=/assist region=us-east-1 error="coercion: attempted array->object mapping failed" sample=t teb
```
anika: /assist often chains a reranker + tool invocation. If model returns a list of candidates as a top-level array, our coercer (permissive=true for canary) tries to map entries -> toolcall objects and sometimes drops required keys.
wes: We recently toggled permissive_coercion for a small canary (5%) in us-east-1 as part of rollout r-0.19. Could be related.
quota-bot: alert: fncall quota attribution spike on route=/assist region=us-east-1  +380% in last 5m.
ops-oncall: If attribution is wrong, customers might see unexpected quota consumption. Can we classify these rejects as non-billable until we confirm?
tamar: Current samples show billing_tag=fncall and route=default; fallback routed to routing.degrade. Bad.
anika: Short plan: 1) change validator sampling to 100% for /assist in us-east-1 for 10m, 2) rollback permissive_coercion for canary cohort in region, 3) short router stopgap: when validator.reject==true and reason contains 'coercion' set billing_exempt=true and route_tag=canary-rollback.
wes: I can flip sampling and queue the rollback. deploy-bot: enqueue rollback for permissive_coercion canary us-east-1 (actor=wes).
deploy-bot: rollback job queued by wes  id=13009  expected complete ~08:03 :rocket:
console-bot: created follow-up ticket ENG-22431 (metrics: validator.shape, dashboard: shape-badge + example payload viewer, routing: billing_exempt flag).
tamar: UX ask: console shows only 'REJECTED' counts. Please surface a compact badge: "shape=ARRAY/OBJECT" and a small inline sample preview (first 160 chars) so SREs can triage in-console. Also add a dropdown to mark this as known-coercion so billing alerts auto-muted.
anika: Also propose a telemetry label "validator.shape_hint" with values {ARRAY,OBJECT,UNKNOWN} and a quick-sample link (hashed ids) for last-N. That will make the alerting math less noisy.
wes: I'll also add a transient dashboard panel to show 'fncall_quota_count' broken down by billing_exempt flag so we can verify router patch.
tamar: One more ask: update rollout console to optionally annotate canaries with a 'coercion-risk' tag so when we enable permissive_coercion we automatically route validator rejects to non-billable until the canary stabilizes. Small UI/DB change but pays off.
ops-oncall: Muting quota and billing alerts for /assist us-east-1 for 45m (mute id M-5187).
wes: Done sampling + rollback queued. Keeping 100% sampling for 10m and will attach 3 representative sample ids to ENG-22431. Early telemetry: rejects trending down. Will update. thread_ts=1825234567 :thumbsup:
